item.description:
Release v5.7.1

Changes since v5.7.0

  • feat(ActivityHeatmap): adjust bar chart heights and format Y-axis labels
  • feat(AgentTurnRunnerPlugin): cascade cancelTurn to child turns sharing parent
  • feat(ConversationListPlugin): add "Project" rail tab to show conversations scoped to current project
  • feat(ConversationListPlugin): OnConversationSelectedHook attach in onReady and scoped header title
  • feat(ConversationManagerPlugin): cascade delete conversation-related data including child conversations and tool calls
  • feat(LLMProviderMiniMaxPlugin): preserve and display raw error response
  • feat(LLMProviderMiniMaxPlugin): preserve HTTPNetworkError body for error display
  • feat(LumiFactory): register StateMonitorPlugin
  • feat(LumiKernel): add deleteToolCalls(for:) to ToolManaging protocol
  • feat(LumiKernel): constrain ConversationManaging publisher for existentials and cross-package observation
  • feat(StateMonitorPlugin): add OnGlobalProviderModelSyncHook to sync global provider/model to current conversation
  • feat(StateMonitorPlugin): clear selected conversation when current project changes
  • feat(StateMonitorPlugin): extract conversation→project sync hook into dedicated always-on plugin
  • feat(StateMonitorPlugin): sync conversation's provider/model to kernel when selection changes
  • feat(ToolManagerPlugin): implement deleteToolCalls(for:) with conversation isolation and write-behind flush
  • fix(ConversationInputPlugin): reduce input lag and restore Return submission
  • fix(ConversationListPlugin): move delete context menu to row level for macOS right-click
  • fix(LLMProviderManagerPlugin): post notifications when provider/model changes
  • fix(LLMProviderMiniMaxPlugin): normalize truncated tool-call arguments to avoid MiniMax error 2013
  • fix(MessageManagerPlugin): drain PendingMessageBuffer before deleting conversation
